how_run: Claude Code workflows (label_batches.js), one fresh subagent per batch; it reads the prompt v1 system prompt and its papers from files and returns labels through a structured-output schema
papers: the 2,300 papers with reference labels (pilot 300 + training 2,000), shuffled with seed 7
result: 2300/2300 labelled, 0 missing; median 2.3 min per batch; about 2.4M subagent tokens
